name: GHCL Ltd
about: Established 1983, GHCL Limited is engaged in the business of manufacturing and trading of Inorganic Chemicals (Soda Ash).[1][2]
keyPoints: Company Overview[1] GHCL is a leading Indian soda ash and raw salt manufacturer with an integrated soda ash value chain. The company focuses on manufacturing excellence, capacity expansion, process optimisation and sustainability-led operations. It serves 272 customers and is increasingly expanding into value-added products, circularity and sustainable chemistry to drive long-term growth.
pros: Stock is trading at 1.16 times its book value
Company has been maintaining a healthy dividend payout of 18.7%
cons: The company has delivered a poor sales growth of 4.23% over past five years.
